issues.title: Old OpenWrt IPK container compatibility
issues.symptom: Package accepted by newer tooling but rejected/misread by live OpenWrt/opkg.
issues.root_cause: Live GL-SFT1200/OpenWrt 18.06 expects the older tar.gz IPK container form.
issues.validated_fix: Build immutable updater IPK in the old OpenWrt-compatible tar.gz container format.
issues.release_notes: Stage 1.2.3 changed container only; control Version remained 1.2.2-1.

issues.title: Updater clean-install parent directories
issues.symptom: opkg install accepted package but failed placing nested files/directories.
issues.root_cause: Required parent directories were absent on clean install.
issues.validated_fix: Package/create all required parent directories before file install.

issues.title: Old Nixio mkdir/chmod/umask modes
issues.symptom: Updater Lua fails on numeric mkdir/chmod/umask calls.
issues.root_cause: Old OpenWrt Nixio build rejects the numeric mode usage used by staged source.
issues.validated_fix: Use mkdir without numeric mode followed by chmod strings such as 0700/0600/0644; use string umask 0077.

issues.title: BusyBox stat unavailable
issues.symptom: Updater preflight/runtime fails because stat is missing.
issues.root_cause: Live BusyBox image has no stat/coreutils-stat.
issues.validated_fix: Use shipped narrow helper/equivalent wc/ls permission checks and remove stat from required tools.

issues.title: BusyBox-safe MAC normalization
issues.symptom: MAC normalization fails in live updater shell.
issues.root_cause: Combined tr deletion expression is not portable to the live BusyBox behavior.
issues.validated_fix: Strip colon, dash and dot separately and lowercase A-F separately.

issues.title: Safari same-origin GET may omit Origin
issues.symptom: Trusted iPad updater check fails despite same-origin Opal page.
issues.root_cause: Safari same-origin GET can omit Origin.
issues.validated_fix: For read-only check GET, allow missing Origin; when Origin exists, enforce accepted Matrix/Opal origins. Keep mutation routes strict.

issues.title: iOS 12 controller syntax/API incompatibility
issues.symptom: Staged controller code may fail on mounted iPad mini despite desktop/browser syntax checks.
issues.root_cause: Optional chaining, nullish coalescing and crypto.randomUUID exist in older staged files.
issues.validated_fix: Full-controller iOS 12 audit/transpile/reconciliation required before production claim.
issues.note: Not fully closed as of staging snapshot.

issues.title: Matrix/AUX starvation/freeze/brightness lag
issues.symptom: AUX freezes/catches up or brightness lags under prior sync approaches.
issues.root_cause: Earlier sync/live-state path starved or mismatched follower behavior.
issues.validated_fix: Matrix-owned local rendering with AUX as DDP follower plus accepted no-starve/follower fixes.
issues.do_not_rediscover_unless: DDP architecture or AUX firmware changes.

issues.title: Audio-driven tempo multiplication
issues.symptom: Music/coughs multiply animation tempo and override intended manual speed.
issues.root_cause: Audio modulation incorrectly affected core tempo.
issues.validated_fix: Keep manual SPEED/Motion authoritative; confine audio to bounded accents/modulation.

issues.title: Visual transition discontinuity
issues.symptom: Animations improved internally but scene changes still looked jumpy.
issues.validated_fix: Continuous slew-limited clock, fixed dwell, smoothed audio, continuous sparkle, and crossfade behavior from accepted continuity work.

issues.title: HBNF-Cart SSID cold-start reliability
issues.symptom: SSID may not appear immediately after startup and sometimes requires refresh/toggle behavior.
issues.do_not_rediscover_unless: Resolve with dedicated cold-start/channel test; do not mark solved by unrelated firmware success.

issues.title: Accepted V1.1 source/build provenance gap
issues.symptom: Accepted BIN exists but exact source/toolchain/dependency lineage has required reconstruction.
issues.root_cause: Prior accepted release did not preserve a complete golden release capsule.
issues.do_not_rediscover_unless: Close by completing the active source-reconciliation/rebuild task and creating the first full capsule.
